## 2D Slice
Say your slice goes from point $P$ towards direction $D$. If you are cool with Geometric Algebra, then the slice line can be written using the join product ($\vee$):

$$ L_{\text{world}} = P \vee D$$

Put this line into the model space of the object being cut using the sandwich with the motor $M$ that takes you from world to model space:

$$ L_{\text{model}} = ML_{\text{world}}M^{-1}$$

Use Math2d's orientedDist(vertex, lineModel) function to determine which vertices belong to shapes created after the slice.

Add extra vertices to both shapes when the line cuts through an edge.
